content.title: Chapter 26 - CIVIL EMERGENCY, EMERGENCY, OR LOCAL DISASTER — Sec. 26-36. - Term of declaration.

faqs.a:
The declaration of a civil emergency, emergency, or disaster shall be in effect as
               determined by the city manager for a period of up to seven calendar days. This period
               may be extended upon submission of a request by the city manager and the approval
               of the city council. In the event a quorum of the city council cannot be assembled
               to approve a continuance of the declaration, such declaration shall remain in effect
               until such time as a quorum can be assembled. In the event a quorum of the city council
               can meet to provide the city manager with advice and consultation during the pendency
               of a declaration, such meeting shall be held in compliance with the Colorado Open
               Meetings Law and city council rules and procedures as soon as possible, but in no
               event later than seven calendar days following the initial declaration.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 2, 12-5-2022)
